message.content:
The bug is that after following a differential parent pointer (line 11), the new `j` is not revalidated against `d->state_count` before being used as an index (line 14). The check on line 6 only validates the initial `j`, not subsequent parents. A parent could point out of bounds, causing `d->accept[j]` to read out of bounds.

The primary introduction of the bug is line 11, where `j` is reassigned without rechecking bounds.

Answer: 11
